contentText: Despite playing with 10 men for 100 minutes, Mali held on to beat Tunisia on penalties and book their spot in the next round. They'll meet Senegal, who also came from behind to beat Sudan 3-1, with Sadio Mané becoming the player with the most assists in AFCON history. We also take a look at hosts Morocco's preparation ahead of their clash with Tanzania, while South Africa will face Cameroon in Sunday's other fixture.
